title: Job Roles in the Media Industry (Part 2)

flashcard_questions.q: The creative lead of a media production who holds the overall creative vision, works with the team from pre-production through to the final edit, and ensures all technical and creative elements come together.
A self-employed worker who is hired for specific projects or contracts rather than being permanently employed by one company.
The sequence of job roles a person moves through over their working life, typically progressing from junior to senior positions.

flashcard_questions.a: Skills that can be applied across different jobs, roles, and industries, such as communication, problem-solving, and teamwork.

flashcard_questions.q: Which senior role manages the schedules, budgets, crew and equipment for a whole project?
